description: Pierce County publishes a polyline representation of its railroad network in Washington, excluding abandoned tracks. The native Socrata metadata defines a stable county identifier, rail owner, rail type, digitizing source, edit date and line-length fields. The layer can support rail-network representation and spatial analysis, although connectivity, service frequency and operating capacity are not established by the catalogue description. Access is through the public county table, with schema information in API metadata. The county requires users to consult its terms of use; this review does not establish a standard open licence. A separately inspected county metadata page reports a January 2026 revision, while Socrata gives a July 2024 data-update timestamp. Synchronization between these publications remains unresolved, so current alignment accuracy is not claimed. No line coordinates were retrieved. The related county catalogue provides the broader collection context.
